title: Property-based testing infrastructure with a shrinking and reporting policy
question: Phase 10 layer 13. Target: stand up the property-test substrate — generators for the domain types (work unit, receipt, council spec, workflow DAG), a shrinking policy, and a reporting format that records the minimal counterexample plus its seed. Which domain types have no generator, and are therefore unreachable by any property test?
answer: 229 schema-backed domain types have no generator. The four named types (work unit, receipt, council spec, workflow DAG) do. Nested records (participant, stopping rule, routing, param, param binding, workflow node) are produced only via their parent.

seed.policy: unlimited re-runs ONLY with a new recorded seed

policy.name: cyclic-core-then-greedy-local-minimum
steps: Drop every node and edge that does not lie on a directed cycle.
Greedily delete remaining nodes then edges while the property still fails.

evidence.claim: A planted workflow-DAG cycle is found from a recorded seed and shrunk to a strictly smaller cyclic core. Same seed replays the identical first counterexample.
Every named domain type (work unit, receipt, council spec, workflow DAG) has a generator covering its schema field space; every other schema-backed domain type on this tree is listed as ungenerated.

negative_controls.description: The planted generator injects a 2-cycle so the acyclicity property fails. The same generator with plant_cycle=False is the silent good state used by field-space examples.
Inventory fails closed if ungenerated is empty: that would claim every schema-backed type has a generator.

reviewer.notes: Named probe2 re-derives the catalog test from a live schema census and field-space coverage, not from probe1's shrink log.

retry.policy: unlimited re-runs ONLY with a new recorded seed

manifest_registration.note: per-unit only; global unit_manifest.py --write was not run

downstream_consumers.note: measure runs after this receipt is written

residual_unknowns.claim: Hypothesis (or another third-party property library) is not the engine; this substrate is stdlib + jsonschema.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Optional later binding of Hypothesis strategies to the same generators.
